_comment: Documented, human-approved exceptions for data-quality issues. An issue listed here no longer blocks the pipeline, but it is still reported and the stated handling is applied. Source data is never edited. Delete an entry to see the validation gate FAIL.

exceptions.reason: Exact duplicate event row. The first occurrence is kept and the copy is excluded from analysis.
Coverage was not reported this week. The value stays missing; it is not imputed.
112% is impossible for a rate. It is treated as missing, not corrected, because the true value is unknown.
Weekly total disagrees with successful + failed and with the event log. Deployment metrics are derived from deployments.csv (the event records), so this aggregate column is not used.
Same root issue as EXC-004, seen by the reconciliation rule.
